# iCLI

> iCLI gives agents access to iCloud Calendar, Contacts, and Mail through a local CLI with self-contained help, resource IDs, structured results, and recovery instructions.

Start with the agent guide. Before the first iCLI task in a session, update a release installation using `icli update`, then use the installed CLI's help for exact commands, defaults, and side effects. Follow the guide's fallback for older, source, or package-managed installations. Authenticate through private input; credentials are stored in the operating system credential store. Use a connected tool when it already meets the request.

## Start here

- [Agent operating guide](https://managing.software/docs/guide/usage/icloud-cli/agent-guide.md): installation, updating, authentication, task routing, outputs, and recovery.
- [Getting started](https://managing.software/docs/guide/usage/icloud-cli/getting-started.md): human setup and the authentication handoff.
- [Update iCLI](https://managing.software/docs/guide/usage/icloud-cli/updating.md): native updates, older releases, and source installations.
- [Account and output settings](https://managing.software/docs/guide/usage/icloud-cli/account-and-output.md): selecting accounts, private stdin, and response formats.

## Task recipes

- [Download contacts from iCloud](https://managing.software/docs/guide/usage/icloud-cli/contacts.md): JSON export completeness, card properties, contact edits, and groups.
- [Export, search, and manage an iCloud calendar](https://managing.software/docs/guide/usage/icloud-cli/calendar.md): range downloads, event text search with skip/limit pagination, writes, sharing, recurrence, and imports.
- [Search iCloud contacts](https://managing.software/docs/guide/usage/icloud-cli/contacts.md): CardDAV text search, skip/limit pagination, complete contact properties, edits, and groups.
- [Search iCloud email and download attachments](https://managing.software/docs/guide/usage/icloud-cli/mail.md): skip/limit pagination, folders, scoped UIDs, drafts, sending, and mailbox changes.
- [Errors and recovery](https://managing.software/docs/guide/usage/icloud-cli/recovery.md): structured failures, partial results, and uncertain writes.

## Optional integrations

- [Four standalone iCloud skills](https://github.com/manvankaliber/icli/tree/main/skills): install one app skill or the four-skill bundle.
- [Local MCP adapter](https://github.com/manvankaliber/icli/blob/main/mcp/README.md): tools discovered from installed CLI help.

The linked pages are Markdown versions of the website documentation. iCLI operates on iCloud-hosted data, not device-only data, iCloud Drive, or Photos. Structured JSON downloads are not native VCF, ICS, or mailbox archives. The installed CLI's help is authoritative; this index is navigation, not a complete command reference.
